edit.description: sensitivity pins for the two RETIRED needles and for orphanedBlocks

summary: Drive the three retired-narration detectors whose inventory is empty by design: the FLUME_DIR-fallback needle, the --model needle, and orphanedBlocks

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

pins: the FLUME_DIR-fallback needle flags a `?? …` beside `process.env.FLUME_DIR` and not the mentions the inventory allows
the model needle flags `--model` assembled into `extraArgs` and not the engine's own argv assembly
the orphan scan flags an injected doc block followed by another and leaves an attached block unflagged
acceptance: Each of the three detectors is driven against an injected violation and a real negative control; the three refusals still report their empty inventories.
notes: Siblings already carry this treatment — the queue-path and inbox needles, the pre-0.10 shape, the job-seed ignore list. These three do not: their refusals compare [] to [] and nothing proves the detector still fires. Negative controls exist on disk (src/Agent.ts assembles --model legitimately; src/flumeApi.ts and docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md name the env var without the fallback).
